description: Disposition decisions for AMBIGUOUS and confirmed-duplicate entries from the August 2026 supplier intake. These decisions are the result of EP-CAT-P2B external identity research and EP-CAT-P2C conservative governance review. The immutable P1B normalized intake is NOT modified — these dispositions are append-only governance evidence.

governance.approvalEvidence: EP-CAT-P2C conservative disposition freeze report; Founder authorization 2026-08-15
governancePrinciples: Dispositions are append-only governance evidence. The P1B normalized intake is immutable.
CONFIRMED_DISTINCT_FLANKER and CONFIRMED_DISTINCT_NEW_IDENTITY dispositions are supported by AUTHORITATIVE external evidence only.
CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE_ROW and CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE_IDENTITY dispositions are supported by AUTHORITATIVE or REPOSITORY_CONFIRMED evidence.
No fuzzy matching, assumption-based, or SUPPLIER_TEXT_ONLY dispositions are recorded here.
Commercial product existence is not treated as equivalent to supplier row identity. Only entries whose supplier text self-identifies the specific product are dispositioned here.
explicitlyExcluded: All 50 rows from 25 COMMERCIAL_PRODUCTS_EXIST_BUT_SUPPLIER_INTENT_UNPROVEN same-text groups — quarantined for EP-CAT-P3 canonical identity normalization

dispositions.sourceKey: MEN-90-Jo Malone / Dark Amber & Ginger Ally
dispositions.supplierNameExact: Jo Malone / Dark Amber & Ginger Ally
dispositions.notes: Jo Malone London fragrances are genderless by brand philosophy and official marketing — confirmed on jomalone.com. Jo Malone Dark Amber & Ginger Lily is a unisex fragrance. The same product appears in both the LADIES section (LADIES-162-Jo Malone / Dark Amber & Ginger Ally) and this MEN entry. Supplier typo 'Ally' for 'Lily' is consistent in both rows, confirming they reference the same entry. LADIES-162 is retained as the canonical listing. This MEN entry is the excess listing.

La Collection Privée Christian Dior fragrances are genderless by brand policy — confirmed on dior.com. Oud Ispahan is a unisex fragrance in the La Collection Privée line. The same fragrance appears in both the LADIES section (LADIES-216-Oud Ispahan by Dior) and this MEN entry. LADIES-216 is retained as the canonical listing. This MEN entry is the excess listing.

Avroy Shlain 'Endangered' is a LADIES-only fragrance — no men's variant exists. Founder clarification confirmed 2026-08-15 (EP-CAT-P3A close-out). This MEN supplier entry (row 68, supplierNameExact 'Endangered') is a miscategorized duplicate listing of the same commercial identity as LADIES-116-Endangered / Avroy Schlain. The LADIES entry includes the brand qualifier; this MEN entry omits it. LADIES-116 is the retained canonical supplier entry. This MEN entry is the excess listing and contributes zero new MKC identities.

dispositions.supplierNameExact: Rose Oud All fragrances are inspired by the listed designer brands. Brand names are trademarks of their respective owners. Prices available on request.
dispositions.notes: This supplier entry suffered data corruption at PDF extraction (EP-CAT-P1B): the supplier's legal boilerplate footer ('All fragrances are inspired by the listed designer brands...') was concatenated into the product name field, contaminating both the raw supplierNameExact and the normalised canonicalCandidateName. The raw and normalised files are immutable — the corrupted text is preserved as provenance. Founder supplied the corrected commercial identity: Kilian Paris — Rose Oud (brand: By Kilian / Kilian Paris). Founder-supplied fragrance reference — Top: Bulgarian Rose, Saffron, Cinnamon; Heart: Tincture of Rose, Litchi; Base: Agarwood (Oud), Cypriol Oil / Nagarmotha, Cedarwood, smoky leather nuances. This entry is promoted from QUARANTINED_IDENTITY_QUESTION (EP-CAT-P3A report) to CONFIRMED_DISTINCT_NEW_IDENTITY and is eligible as a Wave 1 safe pool candidate.
